Monday Minions (Caloosa Riders)

Fort Myers, FL · Road

Monday Minions (Caloosa Riders) is a road group ride in Fort Myers, FL. It rolls every Monday at 6:30 pm from Publix at Colonial Crossings.

For visitors

No registration. Helmet, working bike and front and rear lights are required. Carry two bottles, a speedometer and a spare tube. Come early for the pre-ride safety talk. The club says this and Wednesday's Minions Plus are the best first rides with the club. Weather cancellations post on the CRBC Ride Group on Facebook.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12-14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Minions (Caloosa Riders) group ride

Caloosa Riders' entry-level ride: about 20 miles on shared-use paths and bike lanes at 12-14 mph. The focus is riding etiquette and safety, with no paceline drafting taught or practiced. The group stops together for flats and mechanicals.
